You gain formulas to create these potions as alchemical consumables with the elixir trait. When making these alchemical elixirs, you can substitute alchemical reagents for an equal value of magical components, and you can use an alchemist's toolkit (for Quick Alchemy) or an alchemist's lab (for the Craft activity) instead of any other required toolkits. Other than that, the formula doesn't change. Once you've chosen the potion formulas, they can't be changed.

proposed.clause: Select a number of potions equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1); these potions must be of 9th level or lower.
proposed.freeText: A repeated pick whose COUNT is derived from the character's Intelligence modifier with a floor of 1, and whose option list is filtered to potions of level 9 or lower. The text also says the picks can't be changed once chosen, so the stored answers must be treated as fixed rather than re-rollable.

proposed.clause: You gain formulas to create these potions as alchemical consumables with the elixir trait.
proposed.freeText: No lane in the manual covers adding entries to a character's known-formula list. The requirement: each chosen potion must appear among the character's known formulas AND be re-typed there as an alchemical consumable carrying the elixir trait — so that it counts as an elixir everywhere the sheet asks 'is this an elixir', including whatever pools Quick Alchemy and Advanced Alchemy draw from. The re-typing, not just the formula, is the load-bearing half.

proposed.clause: You gain formulas to create these potions as alchemical consumables
proposed.freeText: The selected potions must join the character's known formulas so they become producible through Quick Alchemy and the daily advanced-alchemy allotment, i.e. they have to appear in the pools those systems draw from.

proposed.clause: as alchemical consumables with the elixir trait
proposed.freeText: No lane covers this: the feat rewrites the identity of another record. A potion — a magical consumable — must exist on this character's sheet as an ALCHEMICAL consumable carrying the elixir trait, so that everything keyed to alchemical items and to the elixir trait (Quick Alchemy, advanced alchemy, alchemist feats keyed to elixirs) sees it. The sheet needs a way to hold a re-typed variant of an existing item rather than the item itself.

rows.name: Endless Memories
rows.text: You've lived a thousand lives and done a hundred-thousand things. When you choose a skill in which to become trained with Ancient Memories, you can also choose a skill in which you're already trained and become an expert in that skill. This lasts until your Ancient Memories expires. When the effects of Ancient Memories and Endless Memories expire, you can retrain one of your skill increases. The skill increase you gain from this retraining must either make you trained in the skill you chose with Ancient Memories or make you an expert in the skill you chose with Endless Memories.

proposed.clause: you can also choose a skill in which you're already trained
proposed.freeText: The sheet must let the player pick one skill from among the skills they are already trained in, and remember that pick for the duration (the pick is made fresh each time Ancient Memories is used, not fixed at character build).

proposed.clause: and become an expert in that skill
proposed.freeText: Your own proficiency rank in the chosen skill rises trained -> expert, and every number derived from it (the skill modifier, and any DC or check that reads that rank) must move accordingly. Unlike the usual rank-upgrade case this is not a permanent level-keyed step: it is temporary and its target is chosen at use time.

proposed.clause: When the effects of Ancient Memories and Endless Memories expire, you can retrain one of your skill increases. The skill increase you gain from this retraining must either make you trained in the skill you chose with Ancient Memories or make you an expert in the skill you chose with Endless Memories.
proposed.freeText: Printed permission that after the effects lapse the character may retrain one skill increase, restricted to the two skills that were chosen. The player performs the retrain themselves; the sheet only has to state the permission and its restriction.

proposed.clause: This lasts until your Ancient Memories expires.
proposed.freeText: A turn-on/turn-off state whose lifetime is borrowed from a different ability (Ancient Memories), carrying the expert rank while running and reverting the skill to trained when it ends.

proposed.clause: When you choose a skill in which to become trained with Ancient Memories, you can also choose a skill in which you're already trained
proposed.freeText: A second pick offered at daily preparations, alongside the Ancient Memories pick. The player must choose one skill, and the offered set is restricted to skills the character is ALREADY trained in (so the picker's legal options depend on the character's current proficiencies, including the Lore skills they happen to have).

proposed.clause: This lasts until your Ancient Memories expires.
proposed.freeText: The expert rank's duration is not its own — it is bound to the parent record's pick. Both picks must be made at the same daily preparation and both must clear at the next one, on one shared clock; there is no Endless Memories pick without a live Ancient Memories pick.

proposed.clause: When you choose a skill in which to become trained with Ancient Memories, you can also choose a skill…
proposed.freeText: This feat has no effect of its own — it edits what another record (Ancient Memories) does when used, turning that feat's one pick into two and hanging a second effect off it. The sheet must be able to attach a rider onto another feat's activation rather than treating this as a standalone grant.

proposed.clause: and become an expert in that skill. This lasts until your Ancient Memories expires.
proposed.freeText: A temporary state that raises the chosen skill's proficiency RANK one step, trained to expert, for everything that skill feeds (its check, and any DC built from it), and then drops back. Two unusual parts: the thing being changed is a rank rather than a bonus, and the duration is not its own — it must end exactly when the other feat's effect ends.

proposed.clause: When the effects of Ancient Memories and Endless Memories expire, you can retrain one of your skill increases. The skill increase you gain from this retraining must either make you trained in the skill you chose with Ancient Memories or make you an expert in the skill you chose with Endless Memories.
proposed.freeText: The player may go back and reassign one already-spent skill increase, and the replacement pick is legal only if it lands on one of the two skills named during the expired effect. So the sheet needs to (1) let a locked-in skill-increase pick be changed after the fact, outside the normal downtime retraining route, and (2) remember which two skills were chosen while the effect ran, since they define what the new pick is allowed to be. Nothing in the lane list covers a grant that reaches back and rewrites an earlier advancement choice.

rows.name: Resilient Touch
rows.text: Your healing energies create an aura of protection that defends your allies against more than just blades and arrows. An ally that recovers Hit Points from your Lay on Hands gains a +1 status bonus to their saving throws until the end of their next turn.

rows.name: Amplifying Touch
rows.text: Your healing energies empower attacks. An ally that recovers Hit Points from your Lay on Hands gains a +1 status bonus to their attack rolls and deals 1 additional spirit damage on all their Strikes until the end of their next turn. In addition, all their Strikes are holy until the end of their next turn.

rows.name: Healing Sanctuary
rows.text: When you call upon your deity's power, you also radiate a sense of safety that fortifies your allies. An ally who begins their turn in your Shield the Faithful aura gains 10 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 round.

rows.name: Fortunate Blow
rows.text: You set an enemy up for a devastating follow-through from your allies. When you successfully damage an opponent with either Guiding Shot or Set-Up Strike, the next creature other than you to attack the same target before the start of your next turn rolls twice on their attack roll and takes the higher result.

rows.name: Phalanx Formation
rows.text: You know how to clear a line of fire for your allies. You don't provide lesser cover to enemies against your allies' attacks.

rows.name: Mastermind's Eye
rows.text: When you succeed at identifying a creature using Recall Knowledge, that creature is off-guard against your attacks until the start of your next turn; if you critically succeed, it's off-guard against your attacks for 1 minute. This feat serves as the rogue's Mastermind racket for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.

proposed.clause: This feat serves as the rogue's Mastermind racket for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.
proposed.freeText: The sheet must record that holding this feat satisfies the 'Mastermind racket' prerequisite when eligibility for other records is checked, so that feats and options gated on being a Mastermind rogue become selectable. It must do so WITHOUT conferring the racket itself or any of the racket's own benefits — the counts-as is limited to prerequisite checking.
